steps.text:
Attached `{{p:entity}}_api.js` with a minimal Express.js {{p:entity:title}} API using an in-memory store.

It provides:
* `GET /{{p:entity}}` – list all {{p:entity}}
* `GET /{{p:entity}}/:id` – get one task
* `POST /{{p:entity}}` – create task `{title, completed?}`
* `PUT /{{p:entity}}/:id` – update title/completed
* `DELETE /{{p:entity}}/:id` – delete task

Run with `npm i express` then `node {{p:entity}}_api.js`.

Created `Dockerfile` for the {{p:entity:title}} API.

It uses Node {{int:16:24}}, copies `package.json`/`{{p:entity}}_api.js`, installs deps, exposes port {{int:2400:3600}} and runs the app. Build with `docker build -t {{p:entity}}-api .` and run with `docker run -p 3000:3000 {{p:entity}}-api`.
